title: Fix Compliance Calendar Seed Data
summary: Fixed the compliance-calendar seed data and wired the timeline API to actually serve it. RECON corrected the dispatch premise: IFC-306 was CSV 'Backlog', not a false-green 'Completed' phantom, and docs/planning/compliance-calendar.json already held 22 events across 5 SaaS-relevant standards (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, OWASP), no ISO 14001, spanning Oct 2025-Dec 2026. Two genuine DoD gaps remained: (1) apps/web timeline/route.ts read a nonexistent artifacts/misc/compliance-calendar.json, so the API served 0 events; (2) 7 events (EVT-011..EVT-017, 2026-03-25..2026-07-15) had rotted to stale 'scheduled' as real time passed their old lastUpdated of 2026-03-17. Fix: repoint the route at the maintained docs/planning file (1 line), flip the 7 stale events to 'completed', bump metadata (1.1.0 -> 1.2.0, lastUpdated -> 2026-07-26), and add a real-file (unmocked-fs) integrity + functional test that guards event count, standard set, date range, freshness (anchored to the file's own lastUpdated, not wall-clock), and that GET /api/compliance/timeline returns all 22 events. 4 validations pass under Node 22; scoped coverage on the compliance route dir meets thresholds.

gate_results.detail: docs/planning/compliance-calendar.json has exactly 22 events (integrity test AC1).
Standard set is exactly {GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, OWASP}; zero events match /14001/ (integrity test AC2).

No event dated before metadata.lastUpdated (2026-07-26) is still 'scheduled'. EVT-011..EVT-017 flipped scheduled->completed; now 17 completed / 5 scheduled. Verified: stale(past&scheduled)=[] (integrity test AC3).
EVT-018..EVT-022 (2026-08-15..2026-12-01) remain 'scheduled' — not prematurely marked completed (integrity test AC3b).
min date 2025-10-15 (<=2025-10-31), max date 2026-12-01 (>=2026-12-01) — >12-month forward coverage (integrity test AC4).

route.ts path changed artifacts/misc -> docs/planning/compliance-calendar.json. Unmocked-fs functional test: real GET /api/compliance/timeline returns data.events.length === 22 (integrity test AC5). Previously served 0 (RED proven before fix).

pnpm --filter @intelliflow/web typecheck exit 0 (after building web dep chain for domain dist); pnpm exec vitest run src/app/api/compliance = 35 passed (3 files incl new integrity test). Existing fs-mocked compliance-api.test.ts unchanged and green.
pnpm --filter @intelliflow/web lint exit 0 (new test file lints clean); pnpm --filter @intelliflow/web build exit 0 (full Next production build).
Only status fields flipped per the DoD; event descriptions untouched. No fabricated outcome text (repo 'Never Mock/Simulate Data' rule). Seed lives under docs/planning by design.

notes: Premise correction is load-bearing and stated plainly (L31/L36 attestation honesty): the dispatch framing ('phantom -> real vs CSV Completed claim') was factually wrong — CSV was Backlog — but the underlying task was genuinely incomplete (dead API path + stale seed), so the pipeline proceeded on DoD-verbatim scope rather than reporting BLOCKED. RISK-S19-306-02 (docs/ outside the Next build root in a fully standalone deploy) is accepted and unchanged: the fix matches the EXISTING runtime-fs pattern (risks/route + the original timeline route both read repo-relative files via findProjectRoot) and points at the file that actually exists and is version-controlled; changing the deployment bundling model is out of scope for a seed-data fix. Out of scope, tracked: risks/route.ts reads a similarly-nonexistent artifacts/misc/risk-register.json (IFC-100/PG-194).
